user.title: Set up Hungarian Energy Tariffs
user.description: Select your energy sensor and distribution area. Not sure which distribution area applies to you? It's stated on your bill, and you can cross-check it against the [official MVM price sheet]({price_sheet_url}), which is organized by area.

data_description.source_entity_id: A lifetime total is preferred; a daily-resetting sensor also works correctly.
data_description.distribution_area_id: Stated on your bill under "Elosztói engedélyes".

pricing.title: Tariff prices
pricing.description: All amounts are in Hungarian Forint (Ft / HUF). Per-kWh prices below are **net**, excluding 27% VAT (ÁFA) - VAT is added automatically when the integration calculates your cost. Defaults come from MVM's [official price sheet]({price_sheet_url}); confirm them against your own bill, which uses the exact same line items as the two sections below.

electricity_price.name: Electricity price
electricity_price.description: Villamosenergia ár - matches your bill's "ESZ Lakossági 'A1' kedv./piaci ár" lines.

data_description.quota_kwh_per_year: How many kWh/year are billed at the discounted rate before switching to the market rate.
data_description.discounted_price_ft_per_kwh: Net Ft/kWh within your discounted quota - matches "kedv. árszabás ára" on your bill.
data_description.market_price_ft_per_kwh: Net Ft/kWh once your discounted quota is used up - matches "piaci ár" on your bill.

network_fees.name: Network usage fees
network_fees.description: Rendszerhasználati díjak - matches your bill's "Elosztói forgalmi díj", "Átvételi forgalmi díj", and "Elosztói alapdíj" lines.

data_description.distribution_charge_ft_per_kwh: Net Ft/kWh - matches "Elosztói forgalmi díj" on your bill.
data_description.transmission_charge_ft_per_kwh: Net Ft/kWh - matches "Átvételi forgalmi díj" on your bill.
data_description.fixed_monthly_fee_ft: Gross Ft/month, VAT already included - matches "Elosztói alapdíj" on your bill.

error.source_entity_not_found: The selected entity could not be found.
error.source_entity_not_energy: The selected entity is not an energy sensor.
error.source_entity_not_total_increasing: The selected entity must have a total or total_increasing state class.
